description: This PHP source file is a unit test class for the EmployeeSubordinateAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test methods verifying the functionality, validation rules, and interactions of the EmployeeSubordinateAPI, including CRUD operations and service layer integrations.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSubordinateAPI endpoints related to subordinate employee report relationships in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodService
